name: io.github.SarutobiSasuke8/website-content-mcp
title: Website Content MCP
description: Polite, site-scoped website discovery and agent-readable content extraction with caching, commerce metadata and deterministic content hashes.

environmentVariables.name: SITE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Required base URL of the public website this server exposes.

environmentVariables.name: SITE_SITEMAP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional sitemap URL; defaults to /sitemap.xml on the base site.

environmentVariables.name: SITE_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated additional hosts the operator explicitly permits.
